_comment: Every screenshot the guides use, retaken by scripts/screenshots.mjs against the app on a fresh docs seed (volt-app/scripts/seed-docs.ts). A shot is a console path, what to wait for, and optionally an element to crop to, elements to hide and clicks to make first. Images land in static/img/screens/<name>.png; guides show them with ![...](/img/screens/<name>.png).
